get_logger: get a named logger instance for the huggingface_hub library module
set_verbosity_info: set the huggingface_hub root logger verbosity level to INFO
set_verbosity_debug: set the huggingface_hub root logger verbosity level to DEBUG
get_verbosity: get the current logging verbosity level of the huggingface_hub root logger
disable_propagation: disable log propagation so huggingface_hub logs are not forwarded to parent loggers
